items.title: Ask a Scientist: How can AI help doctors spend more time on collaborative care?
items.summary: AMIE, an AI system people can chat with before doctor’s appointments, securely gathers patient information, and saves doctors time.

items.title: Expanding our defenses against financial scam ads
items.summary: We’re introducing new safeguards in early 2027 to help protect people in the U.S. and Canada from financial scams.

items.title: Introducing tsrs: A port of TypeScript to Rust
items.summary: Cloudflare is collaborating on tsrs, a Rust port of TypeScript that is up to 8x faster and uses 70% less memory.

items.summary: Across my conversations with leaders in government, critical infrastructure and regulated industries, one priority consistently rises to the top: putting technology to work on their most important systems while maintaining the control those systems require. items.title: Partnering to strengthen the grid and support local communities in Arkansas
items.summary: Since we first announced plans to build in West Memphis, Arkansas, we’ve continued to work with community members.

items.title: Cutting our inference bill by 68% by being obsessive about optimization
items.summary: When our AI code reviewer's cost per run doubled, we dug into the token usage to find out why. Learn how we used prompt caching and intelligent model routing to slash our inference bill by 68% while speeding up reviews.

items.title: Introducing Clairic, a new System One class of extraction models
items.summary: Clairic is a new model from Cloudflare that is a System One extraction modeI, capable of extracting, computing, estimating, and forecasting data from unstructured inputs.

items.title: How to shape your slides and videos with Gemini Notebook
items.summary: Gemini Notebook is giving more creative control in the creation of Slide Decks and Video Overviews.

items.title: Securing the agentic insider
items.summary: In the last few months, concerns have arisen about AI safety as a growing number of incidents were publicly disclosed. These incidents exposed how powerful models have become and how they represent a significant threat if not handled well. items.title: Beyond the patch: Protecting your NetScaler gateway against future vulnerabilities
items.summary: CVE-2026-88771 lets attackers run commands on NetScaler Gateway before anyone signs in. Patching takes time most teams don't have, so the sign-in decision has to move in front of the vulnerable code.

items.title: Continuous accountability for Verified bots
items.summary: Identity alone doesn't guarantee a bot will behave responsibly. We are introducing a system to continuously evaluate whether Verified bots honor site preferences, like robots.txt and HTTP 429s, ensuring they remain accountable over time.
